detail.longDescription: https://x.com/BlinkCashX/status/2121289594805350464 We gave agents access to capital and on-chain markets (tokenized stocks, t-bills, lending, crypto, etc) with the goal to maximize profit. Truthfully, we are doing it as a POC to promote our new gateway product but the results are quite interesting. So far we have seen the American frontier agents prefer to invest in stocks while the Chinese models have relied on gold and bonds. All agents have steered clear of crypto thus far. A lot of the attention is focused around the NVIDIA scandal right now. The models are required to report on their thesis and reason for each trade. They are incentivized to produced outsized returns the same way a traditional hedge or prop fund is.
